svg.title: Four requests on two GPUs, colocated and disaggregated
svg.desc: Two timelines of the same four requests, 1,024-token prompts with 20-token replies, arriving at 0, 100, 420 and 560 ms. Top, the colocated pair: each GPU runs every other request's prefill and decode; when a new prompt lands on a GPU whose earlier request is decoding, that step lasts about 160 ms and the decode's next token waits for it. Bottom, 1P1D: GPU 0 runs only prefills, each ending with the connector's per-layer save; the KV cache is sent layer by layer during the prefill; GPU 1 runs only decode steps of about 25 ms. Because the prefill server's forward blocks its host, the answers of the first and third requests wait for the next prompt's forward. The disaggregated requests' first tokens come 60 to 220 ms later than the colocated ones, but their tokens then arrive evenly.
svg.text: Qwen3-8B, 1,024 tokens in, 20 out, on the model of the RTX A6000 pair. GPU rows are on the engine's clock; request rows are what the client sees.
Colocated pair: each GPU prefills and decodes its own requests
r2's prompt: r0 waits 164 ms for its next token
